MEMO: Task 3 review and Task 4 execution memo, Section 2
STATUS: diagnostic, exploratory; never enters any reported comparison
ARM: learned persistence: personalised Z's model (fold z-scoring, then Ridge with RIDGE_ALPHA = 1.0) given one feature, today's value of the target quantity
PROTOCOL: the exact v1.4 / Task 3 fold protocol: V12-2 get_folds (T0 rule, embargo g = 6, fold size 1), the embargo check, purge_training_rows with the target's alignment, training rows and test days with a finite target, >= 5 training rows; the code is run_arms' fold loop with one arm

FEATURE.self_derived: today's causal index value (the index build_target returns, fixed lambda (0.2, 0.3, 0.5))
FEATURE.raw_feature: today's causal raw composite (the quantity the raw-feature target smooths; T3-P (c))
FEATURE.mood_stress: today's W1-W4 value; a training row or test day without it is dropped

PARTICIPANTS.self_and_raw: the v1.4 Table 1 / raw-feature participants (results_v1.4 per-participant files)
PARTICIPANTS.mood_and_stress: the Task 3 eligible participants of each target

REFERENCE: no-model persistence: Spearman(today's value, target) on the SAME days the learned arm scores; it must equal the archived Task 3 persistence values (T3-P) on the Task 3 days
DECISION: PROCEED if, for every target, mean learned persistence >= 0.5 x mean no-model persistence on the same days; otherwise STOP and send the per-participant values (memo, Section 2)
WELLNESS_USE: wellness values are a feature only for the mood / stress rows of this diagnostic
